title: Memory pressure and cache limits
focus: Find whether memory-pressure handling can fail to reduce retained assets or repeatedly allocate new objects.

title: World actor creation and cleanup
focus: Check whether departed references, lights, or queued entries remain allocated or spawn duplicates.

title: Live imports and prefetch growth
focus: Check import deduplication, retries, and prefetch queue growth.

title: NPC mesh and actor lifetime
focus: Check mesh caching, failed imports, stale actors, and cleanup when characters leave.

title: NPC animation and T-pose handling
focus: Check rest-pose initialization, stale pose handling, and interpolation for a concrete defect.

title: Terrain material readiness
focus: Investigate source-level causes of missing textures or checkerboard materials; distinguish shader compilation assumptions from proven defects.

title: Water lifecycle and flow application
focus: Check duplicated water actors, material rebuilds, and flow data application.

title: Launcher and duplicate processes
focus: Check whether startup or restart paths can create duplicate editors, leave workers alive, or miss launch failures.

title: Asset conversion failure recovery
focus: Check request handling, success markers, partial conversion output, and recovery after interruption.

title: Offline import completion reporting
focus: Check whether failed imports can be mistaken for success, and whether resume behavior is reliable.

title: HUD and menu focus transitions
focus: Check focus and window-state transitions for a concrete way the game could stop receiving input or lose the HUD.

title: Weather effect cleanup
focus: Check rain and weather-effect creation, hiding, and cleanup across transitions.
